desc.en: The Emir Abdelkader Mosque is a Sunni mosque located in the city of Constantine, in the Constantine Province of Algeria.
desc.es: Gran mezquita en la zona de Constantina, con el nombre del emir Abdelkader.

desc.en: The Sidi Belahcen Mosque, also known as Sidi Bel Hasan Mosque or Sidi Abu al-Hasan Mosque is a former mosque in the city of Tlemcen, Algeria.
desc.es: Mezquita histórica en Tlemecén, en el oeste de Argelia.

desc.en: Hammam Maskhoutine (Arabic: حمام المسخوطين, English: "bath of the damned") is a thermal complex located in Hammam Debagh, of Guelma Province, Algeria.
desc.es: Aguas termales y formaciones de travertino cerca de Guelma.
